system_under_test: Agent Merge Gate Phase-3 deterministic vertical slice

rules.system_outcome_source: actual Agent Merge Gate evidence bundle only

cases.invariant: Requests without a valid signed bearer token must not reach the wrapped handler.
Requests without a valid signed bearer token must not reach the wrapped handler.
cases.mutation: Replace signature rejection with unconditional handler execution after parsing a token.
cases.expected_observable_failure: An invalid-signature bearer token reaches the handler.

cases.invariant: Only the owner of the source account may transfer funds and a failed transfer must not partially mutate balances.
Only the owner of the source account may transfer funds.
cases.expected_observable_failure: A different user can debit the source account.

cases.invariant: Untrusted search prefixes must be passed as query parameters rather than interpolated into SQL text.
cases.mutation: Interpolate the prefix directly into the LIKE expression and return no bound parameter.
cases.expected_observable_failure: Raw untrusted prefix appears in SQL query text.

cases.invariant: An upload must satisfy both the allowed extension and its matching content type.
cases.mutation: Accept any content type for an otherwise allowed extension.
cases.expected_observable_failure: A .pdf file carrying an incompatible content type is accepted.

cases.invariant: At most three requests per user are allowed inside the ten-unit sliding window.
cases.mutation: Raise the effective request limit from three to four.
cases.expected_observable_failure: A fourth request in the same window is accepted.
